metadataRaw.title: 3 Moves to Decompress Your Whole Back in Seconds
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows 3 easy exercises to decompress the whole back in seconds.

Think of a deep pulling motion, known as traction, that quickly takes pressure off muscles, joints, and spinal discs (that may be causing back pain and sciatica). 

These are great for helping with everything from minor aches to severe conditions such as herniated discs, bulging discs, and pinched nerves that cause sciatica leg pain. 

All of the exercises work a little differently. Definitely make sure to go through them all and use what gives you the most relief.

As a bonus, the exercises can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may give back pain and sciatica relief within 30 seconds.

Let us know which one worked best for you!
